category.reason: The task requires evaluating a conjunction of a rating threshold and a photographer identity, then choosing an action based on the result.

instruction.en: If this work has a rating above 9 and its photographer is not 孙霄, tap "想读" to save it; otherwise, tap the back button.
instruction.zh: 如果这部作品的评分高于 9 分并且摄影师不是孙霄，就点击“想读”进行收藏；否则点击返回。
